subject.title: Feature: Trigger model fallback on context length exceeded

question: Should context overflow remain compaction-only, or should OpenClaw support a guarded replay on a larger-context fallback model after local recovery is exhausted?
rationale: Current documentation intentionally excludes context overflow from automatic failover, while enabling it changes model-routing and session-replay semantics that cannot be safely chosen by an implementation worker.

options.title: Keep compaction-only
options.body: Retain the documented behavior and close this feature request after documenting the rationale and user recovery path.

options.title: Sponsor guarded larger-context fallback
options.body: Define replay, headroom, persistence, and observability requirements, then implement fallback only after normal overflow recovery fails.

options.title: Improve recovery without model switching
options.body: Prioritize clearer overflow recovery and rotation tooling while preserving compaction-only model routing.

recommendation.title: Keep compaction-only
recommendation.body: Retain the documented behavior and close this feature request after documenting the rationale and user recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work and prior review span the fallback and embedded-runner boundaries where this product contract must be made.
